Workspace tenant · lines 49–130 · Medium

Adds resolveWorkspaceFeedbackTenant, which:

  • requires workspace access via requireUnifyFeedbackWorkspaceAccess,
  • loads feedback directories for the workspace,
  • trims directory IDs to normalize Hub tenant_id matching,
  • optionally enforces access to a specific dataset (datasetId) with a forbidden response when not permitted,
  • rejects misconfiguration states (no datasets assigned; multiple datasets without an explicit datasetId),
  • returns a single resolved tenant/dataset context plus the full allowed tenant set.

Transcribed from the captured original summary. This comparison checks content and hierarchy; it does not establish a measured speed improvement. The prototype includes seven of 52 file diffs. Other content remains labeled as preview.
